title: Mapping Overlaps in Benchmarks through Perplexity in the Wild
reasoning: The paper conducts a comprehensive meta-evaluation of 88 benchmarks, explicitly including and analyzing performance overlaps for categories such as 'world religions', 'ethics', 'moral disputes', 'philosophy', and 'moral scenarios' (primarily within the MMLU and BBH datasets) as part of its methodology for mapping LLM capabilities.
